subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept @microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0 carrying the complete sandbox configuration envelope on wxc-exec argv for this prerelease plugin?
rationale: This exposure is an upstream SDK contract that the PR cannot mechanically remove without replacing or waiting for the dependency, so security and product intent must determine whether the prerelease boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Wait for non-argv transport
options.body: Pause the PR until the MXC SDK provides a configuration transport that does not expose the complete envelope through process arguments.

options.title: Accept prerelease boundary
options.body: Approve the documented argv exposure for this prerelease external plugin after exact-head dependency authorization and final Windows proof.

recommendation.title: Wait for non-argv transport
recommendation.body: Pause the PR until the MXC SDK provides a configuration transport that does not expose the complete envelope through process arguments.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa identified this exact boundary after direct SDK inspection and is the strongest available routing candidate for the sandbox decision.
